name: upstox-equity-delivery-sell-1k
describes: The same Rs 1,000 sell at Upstox, whose brokerage is a flat Rs 20 with no percentage alternative. The card shipped as MIN(0.1%, Rs 20) and charged Rs 1.00 here — undercharging, which understates a cost basis rather than producing a complaint, and is the more dangerous direction of the two.
